## REQ-RES-PUBLIST-001

**Fields of a PublicationList entry**

The Payload of a PublicationList DataSetMessage (one entry) contains the mandatory fields Resource (name of a resource of MG 7.5.1), Source (unencoded Identification Link of the asset) and DataSetWriterId (UInt16), and optionally Filter (topic-encoded String, MG 7.7), Mode (enumeration OFF_0 … ON_REQUEST_APPLICATION_SOURCE_FILTER_15, default ON_REQUEST_1), Interval (UInt32 in ms, default 0), Precisions (object mapping DataSet field names to a Real ≥ 0, default 0) and Config (enumeration NONE_0, MODE_1, INTERVAL_2, MODE_AND_INTERVAL_3, default NONE_0); no other field.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application supports the resource PublicationList (REQ-CMP-019).
- Scope: MG 7.5.1, MG 7.7
- Refs: MG 8.3.8, SF-067
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.8-1f4ea694, MG-8.3.8-2237c2eb, MG-8.3.8-25e2c8ca, MG-8.3.8-533ce7cf, MG-8.3.8-5ef901d0, MG-8.3.8-6ca0c9bc, MG-8.3.8-86fbe141, MG-8.3.8-b9d2374e, MG-8.3.8-c2821b10, MG-8.3.8-f7d6d15a

> The Filter shall be a topic encoded string as explained in 7.7 Filter Element.
> — MG 8.3.8

Notes: The Value Range of a Precisions entry is 0.0 … 3.4·10^38 (SF-067 (d), GL-ADR-019). Precisions are only used for numeric DataSet fields (excursion in MG B1.1.8).

## REQ-RES-PUBLIST-002

**Entry matches its DataSetMessage and its topic**

The Filter of an entry is present exactly for the resources Data, Metadata, Config and Event and is the Tag of that resource; the WriterGroupName of the DataSetMessage is Resource or Resource/Filter and the DataSetWriterName is the Source of the entry.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application supports the resource PublicationList (REQ-CMP-019).
- Scope: MG 7.7, MG 8.2.3
- Refs: MG 8.3.8, MG 9.1.8, SF-067
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.8-4b0d1d82, MG-9.1.8-50d5be83, MG-9.1.8-7e7fda6f

> In addition to the ResourceType a Tag can be added, e.g. to address a defined DataSetMessage of the resource Data.
> — MG 9.1.8

> The DataSetWriterName of the DataSetMessage of an entry must be equal to its Source (8.2.3 DataSetMessage).
> — MG 8.3.8

Notes: Combines REQ-TOP-022 (Filter structure), REQ-MSG-023 (DataSetWriterName) and REQ-MSG-025 (WriterGroupName) for the fields of the entry (SF-067 (b), GL-ADR-019).

## REQ-RES-PUBLIST-008

**Mode ON_REQUEST_1**

A DataSetMessage whose entry has the Mode ON_REQUEST_1 (or no Mode) is published only as answer to a Get.

- Keyword: MUST NOT
- Levels: L1 MUST NOT · L2 MUST NOT · L3 MUST NOT

## REQ-RES-PUBLIST-009

**Mode APPLICATION_2**

With a Mode that enables APPLICATION_2, the DataSetMessage is published together with all DataSetMessages of the same resource and application in one NetworkMessage on Pub/&lt;Resource> (e.g. all MAM on Pub/MAM); it can additionally be requested via Get.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The Mode of the entry enables APPLICATION_2 (values 2, 5, 6, 8, 11, 13, 14, 15).
- Refs: MG 8.3.8
- Verification: d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.8-0260e61c, MG-8.3.8-242c977b, MG-8.3.8-30c0cddd

> With APPLICATION_2 the DataSetMessage must be published with other DataSetMessages of the same resource (7.5 Resource Element) and same application (7.3 AppId Element).
> — MG 8.3.8

## REQ-RES-PUBLIST-010

**Mode SOURCE_3**

With a Mode that enables SOURCE_3, the DataSetMessage is published together with all DataSetMessages of the same resource, Source and application in one NetworkMessage on Pub/&lt;Resource>/&lt;Source>; it can additionally be requested via Get.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The Mode of the entry enables SOURCE_3 (values 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 14, 15).

- Inventory: MG-8.3.8-1b645328, MG-8.3.8-2f684216, MG-8.3.8-d2000452

> With SOURCE_3 the DataSetMessage must be published with other DataSetMessages of the same resource (7.5 Resource Element), same source (7.6 Source Element) and same application (7.3 AppId Element).
> — MG 8.3.8

**Mode FILTER_4**

With a Mode that enables FILTER_4, the DataSetMessage is published separately in its own NetworkMessage on Pub/&lt;Resource>/&lt;Source>/&lt;Filter>; it can additionally be requested via Get.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST

> — MG 8.3.8

## REQ-RES-PUBLIST-012

**Mode fits the publication forms of the resource**

The Mode of an entry enables only publication forms that exist for its resource (matrix of MG 9.1): an Event entry has the Mode OFF_0 or FILTER_4 (Event has no Get and is published only with Source and Filter), a Metadata entry has the Mode ON_REQUEST_FILTER_9; the entries of the mandatory publications MAM and Health have a Mode that enables APPLICATION_2, SOURCE_3 or FILTER_4.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application supports the resource PublicationList (REQ-CMP-019).
- Scope: MG 9.1, MG 7.5.1
- Refs: MG 8.3.8, SF-067
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.8-118f057e, MG-8.3.8-3c99b825, MG-8.3.8-57cde74e, MG-8.3.8-686fbc4b

> An entry of the resource Event must have the Mode OFF_0 or FILTER_4, because an Event is published only with Source and Filter and can not be requested.
> — MG 8.3.8

> An entry of the resource Metadata must have the Mode ON_REQUEST_FILTER_9 (see note above).
> — MG 8.3.8

> An entry of the resources MAM and Health must have a Mode that enables APPLICATION_2, SOURCE_3 or FILTER_4, because these resources must be published without request.
> — MG 8.3.8

Notes: Allowed topic forms per REQ-TOP-013, mandatory publications of MAM and Health per REQ-CMP-006/007 and REQ-TOP-017 (SF-067 (c), GL-ADR-019).

## REQ-RES-PUBLIST-013

**Interval**

With Interval 0 (default) a DataSet is published on change; with an Interval > 0 ms it is published whenever the interval has expired, regardless of a change in the meantime.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The Mode of the entry enables a publication (APPLICATION_2, SOURCE_3 or FILTER_4).
- Refs: MG 8.3.8, SF-067
- Verification: d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.8-26f5e655, MG-8.3.8-320c9e9a

> By default, any DataSet must be published on change => interval = 0.
> — MG 8.3.8

> If set to > 0 ms it must be published after the interval has expired, regardless of whether a change in value has occurred in the meantime.
> — MG 8.3.8

Notes: The interval applies only to entries whose Mode publishes (MG 8.3.8, SF-067 (e)); the Health heartbeat of 60 s (REQ-TOP-017) applies in addition.

## REQ-RES-PUBLIST-014

**Interval overrides Precisions**

With an Interval > 0 ms the Precisions are ignored: the value is published when the Interval has expired, regardless of the minimum deviation.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The entry has an Interval > 0 ms.
- Refs: MG 8.3.8
- Verification: d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.8-45fd34bf, MG-8.3.8-fe56725e

> Therefore Precisions must be ignored, when Interval > 0 ms.
> — MG 8.3.8

## REQ-RES-PUBLIST-015

**Precisions**

With Interval 0, a numeric DataSet field with a Precision > 0 is published again only when its value deviates by at least the Precision (+/-) from the last published value; a Precision of 0 (default) publishes every change.

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The entry has Precisions and Interval 0.
- Refs: MG 8.3.8
- Verification: d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.8-01cce89c, MG-8.3.8-42cb238d, MG-8.3.8-ac7f1fff

> Each entry of the Precisions object defines the minimum deviation (+/-), a specific value of a given DataSet should have, before it gets published again.
> — MG 8.3.8

> When republishing, it should occur only after a minimum defined change.
> — MG 8.3.8

## REQ-RES-PUBLIST-016

**Config defines what can be set**

Config defines which settings of an entry can be changed via Set: NONE_0 (default) none, MODE_1 the Mode, INTERVAL_2 Interval and Precisions, MODE_AND_INTERVAL_3 Mode, Interval and Precisions; Resource, Source, Filter, DataSetWriterId and Config are read only. A Set carries the complete entry; a Set that changes a read-only field or a setting not enabled by Config is rejected with a status Event with EventLevel Bad.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application offers Set for PublicationList.
- Refs: MG 8.3.8, MG 9.1.8, SF-067
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.8-3b66b545, MG-8.3.8-498c4139, MG-8.3.8-a4583beb, MG-9.1.8-083059eb

> The publishing behavior can be configured between different modes.
> — MG 8.3.8

> Publishing behavior can be set by manipulating Mode, Interval and Precisions.
> — MG 8.3.8

> If the Set changes a field which is read only or which can not be changed according to the Config of the entry (8.3.8 PublicationList), the Set must be rejected and the status Event must have the EventLevel Bad.
> — MG 9.1.8

Notes: The Config values themselves are a keyword-less definition (MG 8.3.8); read-only fields in a Set per SF-067 (f).

## REQ-RES-PUBLIST-020

**Get PublicationList is answered with all addressed entries**

A Get PublicationList is answered with all entries addressed by the topic – without Source all entries of the application, with Source all entries of that asset, with Source and Filter the entry &lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>] – each in its own DataSetMessage of a single NetworkMessage published to the corresponding Pub topic.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The application supports the resource PublicationList (REQ-CMP-019).
- Refs: MG 9.1.8, SF-062
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.8-8718c13f, MG-9.1.8-c44bfa5d

> Via the &lt;Method>/&lt;Resource>[/&lt;Source>[/&lt;Filter>]] combination Get/PublicationList[/&lt;Source>[/&lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>]]], the publication of this information to the Pub/PublicationList[/&lt;Source>[/&lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>]]] topic can be triggered.
> — MG 9.1.8

> A topic, such as Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Get/PublicationList, must trigger a publication of all available PublicationList information, each in its own DataSetMessage added to a single NetworkMessage and published to the topic Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Pub/PublicationList.
> — MG 9.1.8

Notes: Pagination of large answers is REQ-PAG-005, ReplyTo is REQ-MSG-015.
